label: coach_teacher_ecology_first_00
text: Hello, hello![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: coach_teacher_ecology_first_01
text: It’s everybody’s favorite biology teacher!\nMr. Jacq here, visiting from [VAR 0x1107(00FF,0206)]NaranjUva Academy![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp01_00
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Wow, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]. We do seem to
keep
running
into
each
other
lately,
don’t we?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp01_01
text: You’re here as an exchange student, right?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp01_02
text: I’m your homeroom teacher back home, so it\nonly seems fair I come check in on you.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp01_03
text: Tell me—is there anything you’ve been pouring\nyourself into here at Blueberry Academy?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp01_select_01
text: Pokémon battling!

label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp01_select_02
text: Filling my Pokédex!

label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp01_select_03
text: Making new friends!

label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp01_04
text:
No wonder you’re a Champion Rank Trainer!\c
I’d bet you can really go all out against your
opponents at a top-ranked school like this one.
You are one lucky kid![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp01_04b
text:
Wow, really? That makes your old biology
teacher awfully happy to hear.\c
So even in this new land, you’re doing your best
to toss those Poké Balls and never give up.
How about that![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp01_04c
text:
Wow! Have you already made a ton of new
friends here?\c
I hope you’ll introduce me to them when you
have the chance.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp01_05
text: Honestly, I was fairly worried about how you\nmight be doing. Unlike that school trip you\r\njoined, this time you came all on your own.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp01_06
text: But it looks like you’re having a Wailmer of a\ntime here, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp02_00
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Oh, I was meaning to ask you something,
[VAR 0x0100(0000)]...\c
What kind of Pokédex app are you using out
there in the Terarium?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp02_select_01
text: There’s a Blueberry Pokédex!

label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp02_select_02
text: Want me to just show you?

label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp02_01
text: Wow! No way! Someone went and modded my\nPokédex app?![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp02_02
text: Of course, I did make the app open-source so\nanyone could add to it if they saw fit...[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp02_03
text: But who made this Blueberry Pokédex update?\nThe notes here say...a Mr. Cyrano?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp02_04
text: Hmm, now that’s curious. The way this Cyrano\nwrites his code is very similar to Director Clavell.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp02_05
text: And I feel like I’ve heard the name Cyrano...\nsomewhere. Hmmm. But where?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp02_06
text: Well...no matter who he is, he did a nice job with\nthis update. Thanks for filling me in about it![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp03_00
text: Hello, hello, [VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp03_01
text: Guess what! I went ahead and downloaded that\nBlueberry Pokédex update for myself too.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp03_select_01
text: That’s great!

label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp03_select_02
text: Now we match!

label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp03_02
text: It really is! I like the design the developer went\nwith. So blue and cool.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp03_02b
text: Hehe... I do like to keep up with my students,\nyou know.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp03_03
text: Now I’m on fire with the desire to complete this\nnew Pokédex! I’m so excited that I’ve been\r\nrunning all around that Terarium they have here.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp03_04
text:
And one really must take note of the stunning
construction of that dome!\c
Whoever thought up its design must be some
kind of genius![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp03_05
text: So many varieties of Pokémon can live there—in\nenvirons that suit them perfectly![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp03_06
text: It’s the kind of thing you couldn’t pull off without\na great understanding of Pokémon habitats.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: coach_teacher_ecology_trade_01_00
text: I’ll need to spend a bunch of time in the Terarium\nbefore I can complete the Blueberry Pokédex.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: coach_teacher_ecology_trade_01_01
text: Though trading Pokémon is another great way\nto work on completing any Pokédex, of course![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: coach_teacher_ecology_trade_01_02
text: Since we’re here together, why don’t you and I\ntake the opportunity to trade?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: coach_teacher_ecology_trade_01_03
text: Oh, I sure would be happy to get a Pokémon\nfrom you. I think I’ll offer up my Gulpin here.\r\nWhat about you, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: coach_teacher_ecology_trade_01_04
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Now [VAR 0x0101(0001)] is certainly an
entertaining
and
attractive
choice!\c
Thanks so much for trading Pokémon with me![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: coach_teacher_ecology_trade_02_00
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Just to be sure, you’re happy to trade your
[VAR 0x0101(0001)]
for
my Gulpin?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: coach_teacher_ecology_trade_02_01
text: You can’t trade Mr. Jacq a Pokémon if you aren’t\nits original Trainer!

label: coach_teacher_ecology_trade_02_02
text: You can’t trade Mr. Jacq such a rare Pokémon!

label: coach_teacher_ecology_trade_02_03
text: You can’t trade Mr. Jacq a Shiny Pokémon!

label: coach_teacher_ecology_trade_03_00
text:
Wait, I couldn’t let you trade away your only
Pokémon!\c
Make sure you have at least two Pokémon in your
party. Then let’s talk.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: coach_teacher_ecology_trade_03_01
text: I certainly don’t mind if you want to give your\nchoice a nice, long think.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: coach_teacher_ecology_trade_04_00
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]So, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]! Did you decide
you’re
ready
to
trade
Pokémon?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: coach_teacher_ecology_talkto_00
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]I recognize that look on your face,
[VAR 0x0100(0000)].
You’re
hankering
for
a
battle,
aren’t you?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: coach_teacher_ecology_cancel_00
text: Huh? You aren’t? Oops, sorry! I guess I got that\nall wrong.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: coach_teacher_ecology_battlestart_00
text: Well, I’d be delighted to be your opponent!\c\nIt’s nice to have the chance to show off my skills\nnow and again. Here’s hoping I do OK![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: coach_gym_kusa_battlestart_01
text: [EMPTY 62]

label: coach_teacher_ecology_battleend_win_00_00
text: Hehe. You beat me! I really can’t stand up to you\nin battle, can I, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: coach_teacher_ecology_battleend_win_00_01
text: But I super enjoy the chance to see how you keep\ngrowing and developing.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: coach_teacher_ecology_battleend_win_00_02
text: I’ll be here cheering for you, foreeever and ever![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: coach_teacher_ecology_battleend_win_00_03
text: Those are just a little something I thought you\nmight like. Now we can be glasses twins![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: coach_teacher_ecology_reward_00
text: You received a pair of [VAR 0xFF00(0008)]Hexagonal Glasses[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]\n[VAR 0xFF00(0008)](Mottled)[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] from Mr. Jacq!

label: coach_teacher_ecology_battleend_win_01_00
text: Hehe, you beat me again! You really are a\nstrong Trainer![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: coach_teacher_ecology_battleend_win_01_01
text: If you don’t mind having me as your opponent,\nI’m happy to have a rematch whenever you like.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: coach_teacher_ecology_battleend_lose_00_00
text:
Looks like I managed to really pull out all the
stops this time!\c
I’m glad I could show you that your teacher
has some life in him yet![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: coach_teacher_ecology_randomtalk_00
text: Isn’t the Terarium faaascinating?! What a place!\c\nIt’s like you can hardly throw a Poké Ball without\nhitting a Pokémon you can’t find at all in Paldea![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: coach_teacher_ecology_randomtalk_01
text:
It’s so fun to get to pop around to all these
different regions lately.\c
I zone out the whole time we’re flying, and then
I’m just there before I know it! Nice and easy![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: coach_teacher_ecology_randomtalk_02
text:
Oops. I forgot to change out of my sandals for
this visit...\c
I’ll get yelled at for sure if Director Clavell sees
me walking around someone else’s school like
I’m on vacation at the beach...[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: coach_teacher_ecology_randomtalk_03
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)][VAR 0x0100(0000)],
that
[VAR 0x0101(0001)]
of
yours
is
such
a
unique
character!\c
I can’t wait to see how it will continue to grow![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: coach_teacher_ecology_randomtalk_04
text: The Gulpin I traded you is pretty funny, right?\c\nShe’s a real glutton, so she wastes no time in\ngobbling Berries right down![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
